resources.string: ZIP saved. It will be archived when Shizuku connects.
Could not complete the operation. Check the game installation, Shizuku, storage and conflicting mods.
Showing the last saved activation state.
Use + to select a ZIP containing info.json.
Waiting for Shizuku to archive this mod.
State could not be verified. Recovery needs attention.
Shadow Fight Arena is not installed or has no launcher activity.
File SHA-256 values do not match. The game probably updated or another operation changed its files. Choose an action below.
Shizuku or file access is unavailable. Check the connection and permissions.
Not enough free space for the archive, staging files and backups.
The ZIP, metadata or file paths are invalid or exceed supported limits.
The file operation could not be completed. Check storage and file access.
An interrupted operation needs recovery. Backups have been preserved.
Another active mod affects the same files. Disable the conflicting mod first.
A size limit was exceeded: ZIP 1024 MiB, one file 512 MiB, total payload 2048 MiB, icon 4 MiB / 2048 px.
The game could not be opened or stopped. Check its installation and the Shizuku connection.
A payload file is not a UnityFS bundle. Every payload file must begin with the UnityFS header; file extensions are not required.
Show this warning again the next time you return to the app? Hiding it does not disable integrity checks. You can reopen it by holding the mod card.
Restore the saved base files? These backups may predate the game update. Current files will be preserved in the backup folder before replacement; files added by the mod will be removed.
Delete this mod archive and all its backups? Current game files will remain unchanged. This cannot be undone.
No base file backup exists for this mod. Activate a mod before its original files can be backed up.
You have the latest available version.
Could not check for updates. Try again later.
No compatible published release is available yet.
Updates are checked on GitHub at startup. Manual checks are limited to once per minute.
Download opens in your browser. Open the APK and confirm installation in Android.
Game data was not found. Install Shadow Fight Arena, open it, and finish downloading its data.

Mod files are untrusted game data. They can be incompatible, corrupt game data, or exploit a bug in the game’s file parser. Review the target files and continue only if you trust the source. Original files will be backed up.
The displayed name and creator are self-declared and are not verified.
I have read this notice, understand the risks, and accept responsibility for the files and actions I choose.
Allow Mod Loader in Shizuku, then return here.
Use the ADB shell backend on the primary Android user. Root and work profiles are unsupported.
This ZIP could not be read. Other mods remain available.
The stored mod record is damaged. Its backups are preserved; file changes are blocked until the record is repaired.

Recover restores saved originals, which may predate an update. Delete removes this mod and its backups while keeping current game files. Ignore hides only this detected change; a new change will warn again.
No matching mods. Try another search.
No newer mod version is available.
The ZIP will be verified before replacement. An active mod will be disabled and its original files restored. The new version stays inactive. The previous archive and backups are retained.
SHA-256 checks the download against the source manifest; the publisher is not cryptographically verified.
Update rejected: ZIP size or SHA-256 does not match. The installed archive was preserved.
The update source could not be read. Check the connection and the public HTTPS link.
Update rejected: mod identity, version or update source does not match. Check the package metadata.
Generate latest.json, ZIP size and SHA-256 files in each stored mod’s .dev folder. Missing update metadata produces a draft. Each mod uses its own mod ID subdirectory under the publication address.
Use a public HTTPS directory without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
Add a publication address to fill the ZIP download link. Existing files remain when Dev Mode is disabled.
%1$s · v%2$s has the same name or mod ID as an existing mod. Select the mod to replace.
The selected card is kept. If the package changes, its active mod is restored and the new package stays inactive. The previous stored archive is retained.
Connect Shizuku before replacing a stored mod.
The existing mod changed. Cancel and import the ZIP again.
Paste a public, direct HTTPS link to a mod ZIP. The package is checked before import.
The mod link could not be read. Check the public HTTPS link and connection. Details: %1$s
